answer_1.quote: We evaluate our approach on both classification (in few-shot setting, §3.1) and generation (unsupervised text style transfer, §3.2), and perform rich analyses for new insights on LM prompting.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include style-rewritten sentences in text style transfer tasks, such as converting negative Yelp reviews to positive ones or modern English sentences to Shakespearean style.

answer_2.quote: We also report popular metrics such as BLEU (using sacreBLEU), and BERTScore for content preservation, and perplexity (PPL) for fluency.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation for Yelp by rating 100 outputs from each model with 5 annotators.
answer_4.guideline: We enlist 5 graduate students who are fluent in English to rate Content, Style, and Fluency on a Likert scale of 1-5, and collect 3 ratings for each output.
